FAQ

Lara questions, answered.

What is Lara?

Lara is an AI booking agent for car rental companies in Dubai and worldwide. It answers rental enquiries on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and your website, quotes prices, collects documents and confirms bookings, 24/7.

Can Lara quote prices for my whole fleet?

Yes. We train Lara on your cars, daily, weekly and monthly rates, mileage limits, insurance, deposits and delivery charges.

Does Lara collect driving licences and IDs?

Yes. Lara asks for the right documents for tourists and residents and sends them to your team with the booking details.

Can Lara connect to my fleet management software?

Lara sends bookings to Google Sheets, Google Calendar or your team on WhatsApp, and can connect to many fleet tools through a webhook. Tell us which software you use and we will confirm.

Which languages does Lara speak?

Arabic, English, Russian and 100+ more. It replies in the language the renter writes in.

Can my team take over?

Yes. Your team sees every conversation and can reply at any time.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call.

How much does Lara cost?

Starter, Growth and Scale have fixed monthly prices shown on this page, with a one-time setup fee on monthly plans. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise is quoted based on your volume and integrations.
